label:
Naive scalar baseline
(shipped)
note: KernelBuilder.build_kernel as shipped: one scalar op per bundle, no valu, no packing.

label:
Vectorized with valu
(pipeline_width=1)
note: 8-wide valu across the batch; idx/val resident in scratch for a group's whole round-lifetime instead of round-tripping through memory every round; algebraic parity simplification removes one select. No cross-group pipelining yet, so valu's 6 slots are mostly unfilled (see rust_harness stats: 17% fill).

label:
Pipelined, valu-packed
(pipeline_width=6)
note: Interleaves 6 independent groups' instruction streams per phase so valu's 6 slots/cycle actually get filled (a single group's hash-stage dependency chain only offers 2 independent ops at a time). rust_harness stats: valu fill jumps 17%->43%, load engine (the unavoidable per-lane tree-node gather, no vector gather in this ISA) becomes the clear bottleneck at ~99% packing whenever busy.
